title-group.article-title: Targeted KRAS inhibition in pancreatic cancer

abstract.p: Background: Targeted inhibition of KRAS may improve outcomes for patients with advanced pancreatic cancer. We assessed sotorasib in routine clinical practice. Methods: We reviewed 167 adults treated at 8 centers between 2020 and 2024. The primary endpoint was objective response, with survival and toxicity as secondary endpoints. Results: Objective response occurred in 41% of patients after a median follow-up of 16 months. Grade 3 toxicity occurred in 15% of patients. Conclusions: KRAS-directed treatment showed meaningful activity with manageable toxicity. Prospective validation is warranted.
